title: Figures 2-3: Deuterium fusion explosion ignited by ion beam and boron neutron screening
description: Two line diagrams. 'Figure 2. Pure Deuterium Fusion Explosion Ignited With an Intense Ion Beam' shows a chamber with labels D (deuterium rod), h (hohlraum), I (ion beam), B (magnetic field), R (miniature target rocket chamber), H2 (solid hydrogen) and L (laser beam). 'Figure 3. Screening of the Spacecraft, SC, Against the Neutrons, n, By a Boron Diaphragm, b, With Solid...' shows a cone of neutron paths from deuterium cylinder d blocked by a boron diaphragm before reaching the spacecraft.
